name: Houjou Arisa
source:
Arisa is a second-year female student and a classmate of [url=/c7538]Kazuhiko[/url]. She moved from Tokyo to Mihoshi last year. Her father Tetsuo Houjou (北条 哲夫) manages a large company named Houjou Group, and she is proud of that. She is smart and good at studying.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hoshiuta#Supporting_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
